title: omnideploy.json
description: Configuration for the omnideploy CLI. Values here override auto-detection.

name.description: Service/site name used when creating apps on providers.

command.description: Build command for static sites, e.g. "npm run build".

output.description: Folder with the built static site, e.g. "dist".

start.description: Start command for server apps. Must listen on $PORT.

port.description: Default port when $PORT is not set.

healthCheckPath.description: Health check path used by Render/Railway.

env.description: Production environment variables. Values always come from .env.production (never from this file).

optional.description: Variables the app can run without; they may be missing or empty in .env.production.

sync.description: Set to false to stop checking .env.production and setting variables on providers.

providers.description: Per-provider options. IDs created on first deploy are saved here automatically.

project.description: Project name used on the first deploy; defaults to the top-level name.

projectId.description: Saved after the first deploy; later deploys target this project even if renamed.

teamId.description: Deploy into a team instead of your personal account.

siteId.description: Saved after the first deploy. If the site is deleted, a new one is created.

siteName.description: Preferred site name (<name>.netlify.app); a suffix is added if it is taken.

repo.description: owner/repo; defaults to the origin remote.

service.description: Service to deploy to; required when the Railway project has several services.

environment.description: Railway environment, e.g. production or staging.

serviceId.description: Saved after the first deploy. If the service is deleted, a new one is created.

serviceName.description: Name for the Render service; defaults to the top-level name.

branch.description: Branch Render builds; defaults to the current branch.

plan.description: Instance type, e.g. free, starter, standard.
